title: Aon Bachra
body:
Jaffar E Taiyar Da Bachra, Puttar Nu Ay Samjha Vey
Ro Ro Sabaq Parha Vey
Aun Bachra Aey Yaad Rakheen, Shabbir Da Dard Vandave'n
Ro Ro Abdullah Aakhey, Jad Jang Da Vela Aa Vey
<<DIVIDER>>
Akber Tu Pahly Jaave'en
Jis Seenrh Da Puttar Mai Waali Han, Us Seenrh Di Aey Manshah Aey, Tenu Sadqa Veer To Laway, O Panj Meel Da Raqba Honrey, Karbal Tu'n Bahar Ja Kay, Tu Puttar Zameen Tay Aaveen
Teri Maa Day Ser Di Chaadar Vi, Qabay Da Paak Ghilaaf Aey
Odha Kar Kay Puttar Taowafay, Fhir Paak Imam Dy Dar Tey
<<DIVIDER>>
Tazeem Da Sajda Kar Kay, Tu'n Ezan Jihaad Da Paaveen
Rakh Yaad Hamaishah Syedda Dy Ghar Di Yeh Reet Purani
Ban Kay Abbas Da Saani, O' Jad Seenrh Sakina Aa Vey
Sawa'an Di Waaj Naa Away, Oday Saamney Sir Naa Chaaveen
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir Nu Saari Zindagi May, Khud Maula Aakh Bolaya
Raiyat Da Faraz Nibhaya, Aey Adab Tu'n Bhul Na Jaaveen
Sajjad Nu Veer Naa Akhi, Onoh Tu'n Sardaar Bulaaveen
Aj Puttar Mohammad Kamsin Aey, Rakhi Odah Khaas Khiyaal Ay
<<DIVIDER>>
Her Qadam Tay Hoveen Naal Aey, Har Vaar Tay Dy Veen Daad Aey
Kavi Raazi Nay Ajdaad Ay, Eenvey Hoosla Deenda Jaaveen
Tenu Jang Tu'n Pahly Amri Nay, Siffeen Da Haal Suna Nay
Dujaa Abbas Bana Nay, O Kariyeen Vey Nehar Ty Qabza
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik Khoon Da Chaalda Dariya, Dariya Day Naal Baha Veen
Tareekh Day Vich Mahfooz Raway, Aey Jung Hay Bachra Teri
Gal Yaad Rakheen Yeh Meri, Tin Din Taeen Piyasa Rah Key
Run Vich Ya Zahra Kah Kay, Mera Chund Talwaar Chalaaveen
<<DIVIDER>>
Abdullah Aun Day Naal Akber, Gal Aey Wo Aakhiri Ki Ti
Tere Hath Izzat Aey Meri, O' Jad Sir Katwaanrh Da Vella
Away Wich Karbal Bachra, Meri Jaa'nh Tey Sir Katwaaveen
